starter:
-- Highest-margin products, by margin percent
SELECT
  name,
  unit_price,
  ROUND(unit_price - unit_cost, 2) AS margin
FROM products
ORDER BY margin DESC
LIMIT 5;
solution:
SELECT
  name,
  unit_price,
  ROUND(unit_price - unit_cost, 2) AS margin,
  ROUND((unit_price - unit_cost) / unit_price * 100, 1) AS margin_pct
FROM products
ORDER BY margin_pct DESC
LIMIT 5;
